description: Post-capitalistic economics, no PhD required. This project helps people create risk-free stablecoin pools that generate interest and support social initiatives. Organizations create interest-bearing pools to raise awareness and funds. People can allocate and track assets that directly contribute to chosen crowdsourced initiatives, for interest in return, without worrying about market volatility or lost funds. A positive-sum scenario for both patrons and communities.
how_its_made: Crowdstaking.fun uses Nora AI, Foundry, Github Actions, React.js, Chainlink Automations, Gnosis, and Walrus/Sui to create an open crowd-staking platform for organizations / individuals that want to fund impactful initiatives while gaining risk-free interest via stablecoin pools. Crowdstaking is an open-source utility that promotes solidarity through financial primitives. People and organizations can customize how their pools look for each initiative, from the name of their contracts, tokens, and pools, to the themes and logos that their initiatives represent.
